eSIM, Korean SIM or pocket Wi-Fi?

It really comes down to one question: do you need a Korean phone number?

No → an eSIM app, about $12–35
Yes → a carrier SIM at Incheon, ₩27,500 for 5 days
3+ people → share a pocket Wi-Fi

Check your phone first: dial *#06#. If you see an EID, it takes eSIMs.

Save this for your trip 📌
Prices from Airalo, SKT, KT and LG U+: hellonunchi.com/guide

Three things Korea does differently, and the free tools that sort them out:

1. Your age. Korea has three of them, and all three still show up.
2. Your name. Koreans spell it by sound, not by letters.
3. Numbers. Two counting systems, and you need both at the till.

Try them on your own birthday and name: hellonunchi.com

Planning a Korea trip? Three questions people always ask us:

🚇 T-money or the Climate Card?
💸 How much will two weeks in Seoul really cost?
🌸 When do the cherry blossoms open in each city?

Free calculators for all three, no sign-up: hellonunchi.com
